Freewheel MPLS Wednesday Night Ride

Minneapolis, MN · Marcy-Holmes · Road · Gravel

No-drop

Freewheel MPLS Wednesday Night Ride is a road and gravel group ride in Minneapolis, MN. It rolls every Wednesday at 6:00 pm from Freewheel Bike Minneapolis. About 25 miles, 15–17 mph average. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 15–17 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @freewheelbike the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Freewheel MPLS Wednesday Night Ride group ride

A weekly road ride out of the Freewheel shop near the U of M. About 25 miles at 15–17 mph. Road or gravel bike, helmet and light. Sign the waiver through the Strava club event; weather cancellations post there too. The 2026 series ends September 16.
